title: Infinite connections-reload loop after external file change drains battery; idle power optimizations
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Summary

On a laptop running on battery, an idle mRemoteNG instance was measured as the largest single energy consumer on the machine (SRUM: 27–30 % of total energy, above the display), sustaining ~7 % CPU with no open connections. Root cause is an infinite connections-reload loop, amplified by several background activities that run regardless of power state. This issue groups the loop fix and the related idle-power optimizations.

comments.snippet:
Fixed in a5e97098a; available in the nightly containing 49145f280. The same source was installed and exercised on a laptop using a self-contained build with its runtime included.

The full automated suite passed **7,592/7,592**. In the real app, startup loaded the existing tree, minimize/restore worked, and a second launch left one instance. Touching the connection file without changing its bytes produced a skip and no reload; a harmless XML content change produced exactly one reload over 70 sec...
